stories.title: Huracán Polo se intensifica nuevamente a categoría 5

en.title: Hurricane Polo intensifies again to category 5
en.summary: Hurricane Polo strengthened to category 5 while moving parallel to Mexico's Pacific coast toward Baja California Sur, where forecasters predict it could make landfall as a category 1 or 2 storm early next week.

stories.title: Rechaza Trump cesar hostilidades con Irán

en.title: Trump rejects ceasefire proposal with Iran
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump declined Iran's offer to halt hostilities and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. According to U.S. officials, Trump indicated to advisers his intention to resume bombing operations against Iran after November's midterm elections.

stories.title: Una noche de gritos y frenesí por concierto de Stray Kids en el GNP

en.title: A night of screams and frenzy for Stray Kids concert at GNP
en.summary: More than 60,000 young fans filled the GNP stadium for a Stray Kids concert, greeting the group's appearance with deafening cheers and collective excitement on Friday evening.

stories.title: Condena la ONU los ataques hutíes contra Arabia Saudita

en.title: UN condemns Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The UN Security Council condemned escalating attacks on Saudi Arabia by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis and demanded an immediate end to their military offensive that impacts civilians and civilian infrastructure.

stories.title: "Gracias por amar el K-pop más que nadie": Stray Kids; presidente de Corea del Sur asiste a concierto en Estadio GNP

en.title: "Thank you for loving K-pop more than anyone": Stray Kids; South Korea president attends concert at GNP Stadium
en.summary: The president of South Korea attended a Stray Kids concert at GNP Stadium, where the group thanked their fans for their exceptional support of K-pop.

stories.title: Designan a Francisco Vásquez como Comisionado en Juchitán

en.title: Francisco Vásquez designated as Commissioner in Juchitán
en.summary: Francisco Vásquez, a firefighter and communicator, was appointed Municipal Commissioner of Juchitán by the Governor of Oaxaca, Salomón Jara.

stories.title: Salomón Jara designa a Francisco Vásquez como comisionado municipal de Juchitán; "vamos a devolverles la paz", dice

en.title: Salomón Jara designates Francisco Vásquez as municipal commissioner of Juchitán; "we will restore peace to them", he says
en.summary: The Governor of Oaxaca appointed Francisco Vásquez as municipal commissioner of Juchitán, stating that his administration will work to restore peace to the municipality.

stories.title: Atlante frena mala racha y vence a Monterrey en el Apertura 2026

en.title: Atlante stops losing streak and beats Monterrey in Apertura 2026
en.summary: Atlante secured a victory over Monterrey, moving to thirteenth place with 11 points and providing relief to manager Miguel Herrera.

stories.title: Trump rechaza propuesta de Irán para reabrir Ormuz, revela The Wall Street Journal

en.title: Trump rejects Iran's proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz, reveals The Wall Street Journal
en.summary: The U.S. president expressed skepticism that Iran would meet his demands, leading him to consider renewed bombing campaigns as a probable course of action.

stories.title: TikTok acuerda pagar 100 mdd en para evitar juicio sobre protección de menores en EU; pondrá límites a usuarios jóvenes

en.title: TikTok agrees to pay 100 million dollars to avoid lawsuit over child protection in the US; will limit young users
en.summary: TikTok reached a settlement agreement that concludes a child protection case three days before trial was scheduled to begin.

stories.title: Huracán Polo se mantiene en categoría 5 y amenaza con lluvias muy fuertes a seis estados

en.title: Hurricane Polo Remains Category 5 and Threatens Six States with Heavy Rainfall
en.summary: Hurricane Polo maintained its Category 5 strength while positioned southwest of Jalisco, posing a threat of severe rain to six Mexican states.

stories.title: Huracán Polo se intensifica nuevamente a categoría 5; sigue en vivo su desplazamiento

en.title: Hurricane Polo intensifies again to category 5; tracking its movement live
en.summary: Hurricane Polo has strengthened to category 5 status, with ongoing monitoring of its trajectory.

stories.title: Se debe romper el mito de que bancarizar es fiscalizar, dice la CNBV; defiende Ley de Economía Digital

en.title: Myth that banking is surveillance must be broken, says CNBV; defends Digital Economy Law
en.summary: Mexico's federal government states it has the infrastructure to increase digital payments, with adoption rather than access being the main challenge, according to the financial regulator.

stories.title: Hacienda baja IEPS a gasolinas, mientras el diésel va por su tercera semana con cuota cero

en.title: Finance Ministry lowers gasoline tax, while diesel enters third week with zero levy
en.summary: For the week of September 26 to October 2, diesel used for mass transportation and freight movement will receive a 100% exemption on its fuel tax per liter.

stories.title: La IA aumenta el tráfico de datos y presiona la capacidad de las redes de las telecomunicaciones

en.title: AI increases data traffic and pressures telecommunications network capacity
en.summary: Artificial intelligence usage is expected to raise global data traffic by 26% by 2034, requiring telecommunications operators to expand network capacity and advance toward 5G and 6G technologies.

stories.title: Openbank capta 48 pesos por cada peso que presta; ahora quiere acelerar el crédito

en.title: Openbank collects 48 pesos for every peso it lends; now wants to accelerate credit
en.summary: Openbank is seeking to accelerate its credit portfolio after surpassing 1.5 million customers, with its Chief Growth Officer announcing very aggressive targets ahead.

stories.title: La escalofriante advertencia de Bill Gates sobre la IA revela hasta dónde podría llegar su poder destructivo

en.title: Bill Gates' chilling warning about AI reveals how far its destructive power could reach
en.summary: Microsoft's co-founder has made statements that reignite discussions about risks associated with advanced systems and the importance of overseeing their development.
